Name: Seasonal Grass Paths for Vibrant Pastrol
Author: DuckVendetta
Description:
My personal blend of the Grass Path idea by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51184691]mdscatharina[/url] (not required) to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/91802318]grapeponta[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolour[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url]﻿'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4852]Seasonal Path and Flooring[/url]﻿.

Consider using my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7705]Gravel Sound Replacer[/url]﻿ for further immersion -replaces the gravel sounds with grass sound.

Configuration options include:
-Green Fall: Changes fall from orange to green.
-Clean: Creates grass paths without leaves/petals in fall/spring.
